description: A chó ta: a lean, short-coated yellow street dog with a curled tail and a torn ear.  It belonged to the whole alley, fed on everybody's scraps, and now it belongs to nobody.  Hungry and wary, it keeps its distance unless cornered.
A gà ta: a scrawny free-range chicken with copper and black feathers, scratching through the rubbish where its owners kept it in a cage on the sidewalk.  The fever was blamed on its kind.

//: G28: animals of the hẻm and back alleys.  Kept sparse: the d3_r3 §6.2 per-OMT budget counts them with the zombies.
